episodes.163892: Strong thunderstorms developed across portions of northeastern Oklahoma during the evening of the 24th, as a cold front moved into the area. The strongest storms produced hail.
episodes.164217: A late-November cold front swept through the Rio Grande Valley/Deep South Texas and the Lower Texas Coast during the afternoon and evening of November 25th (Thanksgiving Day 2021). Some convective showers fired up along the cold front as it entered the region and resulted in several measured gusts above 34 knots across the Gulf Waters.
episodes.164491: A cold front on Thanksgiving Day caused scattered to locally numerous showers across Puerto Rico. Total rainfall amounts were between 0.50-2.00 inches, with locally higher amounts, especially across the El Yunque area, where some rivers and streams went into action stage with Rio Blanco in Naguabo going into minor flood stage.

events.narrative: Rio Blanco river went out of its banks, flooding road PR-31 near Exit 22 of Highway 53.

events.county: Waters From Baffin Bay To Pt Mansfield Tx Ext From 20 To 60Nm
events.narrative: A line of showers and thunderstorms associated with a cold front swept through the Lower Texas Coast and over Gulf waters out to 60 nm. A peak gust of 41 knots was recorded at BUOY 42020 (LLNR 1405) at 3:40PM CST. Several gusts over 34 knots were reported between 3:40PM CST and 4:40PM CST.

events.county: Laguna Madre From 5Nm N Of Pt Mansfield To Baffin Bay Tx
events.narrative: A line of showers and thunderstorms associated with a cold front swept through the Lower Texas Coast and over Gulf waters out to 60 nm. A peak gust of 40 knots was recorded at 3:54PM CST at the Rincon del San Jose, TX (RSJT2) Texas Coastal Ocean Observing Network (TCOON) site. Several gusts of 34 knots or greater were reported between 3:42PM CST and 4:30PM CST.

events.county: Coastal Waters From Baffin Bay To Pt Mansfield Tx Out 20 Nm
events.narrative: A line of showers and thunderstorms associated with a cold front swept through the Lower Texas Coast and over Gulf waters out to 60 nm. A peak gust of 40 knots was recorded at the Rincon del San Jose, TX (RSJT2) Texas Coastal Ocean Observing Network (TCOON) site. With the recorded gust of 40 knots at RSJT2, which is within 1 mile of Gulf Waters,  and Buoy 42020, it is reasonable to expect the nearby Gulf Waters out to 20 NM between Port Mansfield and Baffin Bay also experienced similar gusts.
